T917 — Race J runner guard (dsflash lane). Sealed lane: deliverables are untracked/race-j/dsflash/regression-runner-guard.sh + this file; nothing was written to tools/ and nothing was committed. Model: deepseek-v4-flash (canonical). Identifier: deepseek-v4-flash/T917.

HEADLINE: a runnable regression for tools/runner with SEVEN assertions, every one green against the real tools/runner AND red against a seeded-defect scratch copy (never trust a green test). Script exit 0 on two consecutive full runs (2026-08-25, evidence log 1 = untracked/race-j/dsflash/evidence/run-2026-08-25-1045Z.log; a second identical run also exited 0). Live-heartbeat isolation held on both runs (T512/F3: no fixture line reached the live untracked/heartbeat.jsonl).

METHOD: every runner invocation runs from a scratch git repo under /tmp/weizigo/t917-dsflash-* so repo_root (resolved from CWD) sends heartbeats/run-records/tees/ledgers to scratch, never the live repo. Identity via MANAGENT_TASK_ID env only (never --task-id, so no kanban auto-claim). MANAGENT_BIN points the reap at the real bin/managent. RED arms run a copy of tools/runner (+ siblings) under the scratch repo with ONE surgical sed mutation; each mutation is verified applied (missing anchor = FATAL, never a silent skip). One lesson earned mid-lane: mutations were initially cumulative on one copy, and A4's red half 1 (alarm never fires) masked red half 2 (alarm kills); fixed by re-copying the pristine runner per red arm (fresh_mut).

PER-ASSERTION RECORD (claim -> what it asserts -> GREEN observed -> RED observed):

A1 admission refusal (ram-policy.md §4.1): a --ram-mb declared need that does not fit what is already admitted is REFUSED before spawn, not killed; nothing is spawned; the row stays dispatchable. GREEN: avail injected 20000, competitor admitted 15000, candidate declares 4608 -> runner exit 3, 'ARBITER REFUSED' + 'row stays dispatchable' on stderr, no '[runner] KILL:' line, spawn marker absent, no ledger entry for the refused identity. RED: defect = admission arithmetic projected_mb + 999999999 (always fits) -> defected runner exit 0, spawn marker present -> every check above fails. ALSO green null arm: a fit (512 MB) admits, runs, completes exit 0, and its ledger entry is released on exit (no leak).

A2 wall-band RAM declaration at each boundary (60/600/1800 s): the T913 mapping, boundary value lands in the band it STARTS. CANARY: this mapping lives in bin/subagent._wall_band_ram_mb, NOT tools/runner (the runner only consumes the declared value via the arbiter) — the honest gate tests it where it lives. GREEN (real bin/subagent imported in-process): 59->768, 60->1792, 599->1792, 600->3072, 1799->3072, 1800->4608, 1801->4608 (exit 0, BANDS-OK). RED: defect = off-by-one at the 60 s edge (< 60 -> <= 60) -> exit 1, BAND-MISMATCH [(60, 1792, 768)] — the boundary assertion catches the T912 under-declaration class.

A3 --max-wall ceiling: a silent child past the ceiling is terminated and the termination is ATTRIBUTABLE. GREEN: --max-wall 2 wrapping a silent 60 s sleeper -> runner exit 124, '[runner] KILL: wall ceiling 2s', run record killed_by='wall', signal=9, exit field absent, task+run_kind present. RED: defect = wall check elapsed >= max_wall + 999999 (never fires) -> defected runner exit 0, child finished, no record -> assertion fails.

A4 L3 kernel-pressure alarm (ram-policy.md §4.4): sustained kernel pressure (level >= 2, dwell-gated >= 3 polls spanning >= 2 s) fires ONE alarm naming the largest host-wide consumer and appends host_alarms to the run record — and per INV-1 NEVER kills the lane. CANARY (the brief's literal assertion is FALSE-AS-SCOPED): 'the memory-pressure host guard fires AND KILLS the lane when the host crosses its pressure threshold' describes the pre-T821 behavior; T821 deleted the host-condition kill verb — L3 has an alarm verb and no kill verb at all (docs/infra/host/ram-policy.md §4.0 L3: 'no — never'). The gate asserts the live contract: fires, names, never kills. GREEN: WEIZIGO_KERNEL_PRESSURE_LEVEL=2 injected, 4 s child -> exit 0, '[runner] ALARM:' naming a consumer, 'survivor' printed (lane lived), no '[runner] KILL:', record host_alarms[0].level == 2. RED half 1: defect = level >= 99 (never fires) -> no ALARM line -> assertion fails. RED half 2: defect = alarm branch also sets kill_reason (the deleted kill verb returns) -> defected runner exit 124, no survivor -> the never-kills assertion fails.

A5 run record written with its kind declared (T364/T895): a run record lands at untracked/runs/<task>.json with run_kind (dispatch|nested) so reap keys the row to the record's task field and reads pid/exit/signal. GREEN: exit-0 child under MANAGENT_TASK_ID -> record exists, task=='T917DS-A5-GREEN', run_kind=='dispatch', exit==0, end present, pid>0, command echoed. RED: defect = record_root forced None (the F6/T515 class: identity present but record suppressed) -> no record file -> assertion fails.

A7 per-process RSS-cap overrun stop (INV-4): the ONLY memory kill that exists — a task overrunning its OWN declared need (> ceil(ram_mb*1.25)) is stopped and labeled, never a stranger's memory. GREEN: --ram-mb 100 (cap 125), child allocates 200 MB -> exit 124, 'RSS cap 125 MB exceeded', 'overrunning its OWN declared need' note, record killed_by='rss', admission entry released. RED: defect = 'if rss_cap_mb and rss > cap_bytes' -> 'if rss_cap_mb and False' (cap never fires) -> defected runner exit 0 -> assertion fails.

STATUS PER ASSERTION: A1 PROVEN (both controls observed; green rc 3, red rc 0), A2 PROVEN (green rc 0, red rc 1), A3 PROVEN (green rc 124, red rc 0), A4 PROVEN as the live alarm contract (green rc 0, red1 no-alarm, red2 rc 124) with the literal kill-verb assertion FALSE-AS-SCOPED per T821, A5 PROVEN (green rc 0, red rc 0 with no record), A7 PROVEN (green rc 124, red rc 0). Every red observed, none predicted.

NOT COVERED (and why): (1) the reap-side integration — 'reap reads the dispatch record' end-to-end is NOT driven here (managent reap acts on the live kanban store; touching it violates the sealed lane and the no-touch-live-store rule). What IS asserted is the record shape reap consumes (task, run_kind, pid, exit/signal). (2) claude/pi/ollama liveness fuses, startup-liveness, token/session capture, harness-p95, orphan sweeper, directive/auto-claim/auto-close, caffeinate sleep guard — each is (or was) covered by a sibling S09 script (regression-runner-claude-liveness.sh, -startup-liveness.sh, -pi-session-liveness.sh, -agent-progress.sh, -harness-p95.sh, regression-arbiter.sh, regression-orphan-reaper.sh, regression-runner-run-records.sh, regression-runner-taskid.sh) and the brief's five assertions plus the two canaries are the lane's scope; duplicating the siblings would add no union coverage. (3) the mutation anchors are pinned to the current tools/runner source — a legitimate refactor that moves an anchor line makes the corresponding red arm FATAL loudly (re-baseline required), which is the honest failure mode, not a silent skip.

BRIEF-DECLARED ASSERTION MAPPING: brief 1 (refusal, refused not killed, row stays dispatchable) = A1; brief 2 (wall-band boundaries 60/600/1800) = A2 — lives in bin/subagent, covered there; brief 3 (wall exceedance terminated + attributable) = A3; brief 4 (memory-pressure host guard) = A4 — the literal kill claim is false-as-scoped post-T821, the live alarm contract is covered + A7 covers the one memory kill that exists; brief 5 (run record with kind declared) = A5. Load-bearing extras: A1-null (release on exit) and A7 (RSS overrun stop).
